description: Plan and attribute MCP token spend across agents, servers and workflows — something the protocol provides no native support for. Outputs per-dimension cost split and a quota plan.

inputPricePerMillion.description: Input price per 1M tokens in USD (default 3)

monthlyBudget.description: Optional monthly budget cap in USD for over/under comparison

outputPricePerMillion.description: Output price per 1M tokens in USD (default 15)

workloads.description: JSON array of {name, callsPerDay, inputTokensPerCall, outputTokensPerCall, owner?}. Accepts a JSON array, or a JSON string containing one.

name: plan_mcp_token_budget
